name: Hospital Debts
text: Revelation - Put Hospital Debts into play in your threat area. [free] Move 1 resource from your resource pool to Hospital Debts. (Limit twice per round.) Forced - At the end of the game, if Hospital Debts has fewer than 6 resources on it: You earn 2 fewer experience for this scenario.
text_cn: 揭示 - 将医院欠债放入你的威胁区域。 [free]将你资源池中的1个资源移到医院欠债上。（每轮限制2次。） 强制 - 在游戏结束时，如果医院欠债上的资源少于6个：你在本次冒险中少获得2点经验。
